build.beforeDevCommand: pnpm --filter @edutrack/api run build:sidecar && pnpm --filter @edutrack/web run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1
build.beforeBuildCommand: pnpm --filter @edutrack/api run build:sidecar && pnpm --filter @edutrack/web run build

security.csp: default-src 'self' asset:; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' asset: data:; font-src 'self' asset: data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'none'
